why_attention.summary_zh: 从业科普最稳主题。近 90 天 search_posts_all 抽样：D&D 宽口径 ≥25（分页顶满）、free time 严格 ≥24（顶满）、中文滞箱约 10（含广告/链上噪声）。近 7 天真实 counts 仍为宽 70 / free time 53 / 中文 5——90 天无全库 counts API，只能报检索抽样。
why_attention.note: Amounts and free-day counts are carrier×terminal commercial — never invent a global number.

definitions.def: Contracted period before demurrage, detention, or storage charges begin. Often different for import pickup vs empty return vs export gate-in.
Calendar day when free time ends; next day (or next tariff step) starts charging. Confirm timezone and whether LFD is inclusive.
Charge while the loaded container remains inside the terminal/rail ramp past free time (before pickup). Industry convention: 'inside the fence'.
Charge while the carrier's container (and sometimes chassis) remains outside the terminal past free time after pickup, until empty return.
Terminal/port authority charge for occupying yard space; may run in parallel with carrier demurrage depending on local tariff — verify per port.
Some carriers bill a single 'demurrage & detention' ladder; still track physical location of the box for dispute evidence.

who_pays.typical: Merchant (shipper/consignee/forwarder per contract/Incoterms) pays carrier D&D; terminal storage may be billed separately by terminal/NVOCC.
who_pays.note: Who 'stops the clock' during customs exam or terminal inability is contractual/negotiated — FIATA argues free time should extend for periods merchant cannot act.

who_responsible: Merchant monitors LFD, appointments, empty return.
Terminal controls gate appointments / yard release — may affect ability to pick up.
common_pitfalls: Treating demurrage and detention as one fee and disputing the wrong party.
Assuming '3–7 free days' is a law — it is not; it is tariff/contract.
Clock continues during customs hold / failed trucker appointment unless tariff or negotiation says otherwise.
Export demurrage while vessel delayed — FIATA argues carrier should own vessel delay; practice varies.
Chassis per-diem layered on top of detention in some US trades.

faq.q: Demurrage 和 Detention 差在哪？
faq.a: 惯例：Demurrage = 重柜还在码头/堆场内超过 free time；Detention = 提柜后在码头外占有船司箱体超过 free time 未还空。有的船司合并账单，但争议证据仍应按位置分开。出处：FIATA/CLECAT/行业 glossary。
没有全球统一法定天数。由船司 tariff、合约或 NVOCC 条款约定。FIATA 主张应给合理免费用箱期，拥堵/码头无法放行时应等比延长——属谈判立场，非自动生效法条。

faq.q: 查验期间费用钟停不停？
faq.a: 多数情况下并不自动停钟；是否减免看船司/码头条款与协商。产品侧应标「待核实/合约」，禁止写死「查验免 demurrage」。

faq.q: Storage 和 Demurrage 会不会重复收？
faq.a: 可能并行：码头收堆存、船司收 demurrage。逐港核对 tariff，勿假设互斥。
